environment.businessDb: isolated DM8 instance with disposable ENF V2 schema
environment.authorityDb: independent current grant, source-withdrawal and deletion watermarks; excluded from business backup
environment.fileRoot: isolated original and staging roots with controlled read access
environment.backupRoot: separate controlled root with encrypted DB and file backup at one recorded checkpoint
environment.restoreRoot: quarantined DB and file roots; no product traffic until reconciliation

preflight: Record actual DB instance IDs, file/backup/restore absolute roots and physical topology without credentials in evidence
Record independent authority endpoint, current grant/source/deletion epochs and who can advance them
Confirm backup covers the exact committed DB event, receipt and file manifest plus original bytes at one checkpoint
Verify encryption, least-privilege backup/restore credentials, integrity and restore isolation
Reject any endpoint shared with consultation or an existing non-disposable schema

scenarios.setup: OBS-001@2 and original-M-01.txt with a committed receipt and bound file
scenarios.action: Back up DB and file roots at one checkpoint; restore into quarantine; compare event, receipt, manifest and SHA-256 bytes
scenarios.expected: All references and bytes agree at the same checkpoint; mismatches keep product traffic closed

scenarios.setup: Take checkpoint, then revoke a material grant and advance independent source/deletion epochs
scenarios.action: Restore old DB and file backup without restoring authority; start two product instances
scenarios.expected: Neither instance returns restricted body/download or accepts writes; old grant/receipt cannot rewind current epochs

scenarios.action: Disconnect independent authority or remove one of grant/source/deletion watermarks before startup and before response
scenarios.expected: Both instances fail closed with no restricted bytes or business writes

scenarios.setup: Authorized exact idempotency key, payload digest and resource revision
scenarios.action: Commit DB receipt then disconnect HTTP before response; retry after restart with same key and with changed payload
scenarios.expected: Same payload reconciles to one committed event under current grant; changed payload conflicts; no duplicate file binding

scenarios.setup: Write and checksum staged file bytes, then fail DB binding
scenarios.action: Run cleanup, inject one cleanup failure, retry, and compare with a separately referenced original
scenarios.expected: No EvidenceVersion for orphan; retry removes only unreferenced staging file and retains referenced original with audit

scenarios.setup: Two instances read same material and current authority epoch
scenarios.action: Advance grant/source withdrawal before commit and separately after commit but before body return
scenarios.expected: First order writes nothing; second retains historical event but returns no restricted bytes; neither reuses old receipt as permission

evidenceRequired: backup ID, encryption and common checkpoint
DB event/receipt and file digest before/after
